## Description

A rounded square article card contains a small rounded picture panel at the upper right. Two short lines sit to its left, above two longer text lines that extend across the lower area.


## Deferred split

Generate the empty card frame and the interior article layout independently in a later task. Do not draw the complete reference as a solo.

Draw the empty rounded square card border with four matching corners. Exclude the picture panel and all text lines; leave the interior open for centered article-layout content.

Draw the article layout alone: a small rounded picture panel in the upper right, two short horizontal text strokes to its left, and two longer text strokes beneath. Retain the right-aligned image relationship; exclude the outer card border. Center the entire layout inside the later card composition. These strokes represent text lines, not typeface glyphs.
